name: plain-english-to-auto-test
description: Autonomous AI-powered browser test runner that converts plain-English test cases into automated browser tests using Playwright.

scripts.test:demo: tsx src/cli.ts --url "https://phptravels.com/demo" --test "Log in as a customer and verify the dashboard is shown"
scripts.test:headed: tsx src/cli.ts --url "./demo/local-demo.html" --test "Log in as a customer and verify the dashboard is shown" --headed --slowmo 600
scripts.test:local: tsx src/cli.ts --url "./demo/local-demo.html" --test "Log in as a customer and verify the dashboard is shown"
